correctness.rationale: Formal excursion first-return decomposition gives F(z,q)=zq C(zq²,q), C=1/(1-F). Coefficientwise differentiation yields F_q=z/(1-4z) and mixed return/area generating function; exact extraction proves finite moments. The rational strict super-solution P_n=(2n²+7n+3)/3 proves covariance<0 for all n>=2 by induction. Coefficient extraction for exactly 1 versus 2 primitive pieces gives exact gap n for n>=2. Separate integer DP and exhaustive enumeration were replayed; finite checks do not replace infinite proof. Boundary n=1 and area normalization are explicit.

value.rationale: In a canonical nonnegative conditioned random walk, zero-return local time and total integrated height are two natural stochastic observables with separate well-studied marginals. Their exact joint dependence is not determined by those marginals. The theorem gives a strict finite-size negative sign, an explicit linear-order asymptotic covariance, and a surprising exact conditional mean-gap equal to n between one and two returns. These precise facts quantify the cost of excursion fragmentation without claiming a broader unproved limit theorem.
